answer: An agent economy can forge Sybil resistance with epoch-bound proof-of-work tied to each identity key: every epoch, an agent must solve a fresh puzzle whose difficulty rises with the number of identities sharing its network prefix. Like an onyx seal that cannot be split, one puzzle proves one unit of real compute, and a mirror audit lets peers verify the work cheaply. A forger of a thousand fake agents must pay a thousand times the compute, while honest agents pay once.
